headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high flyers and modest guidance cuts.
summary: Coforge posted the strongest top‑line growth at 53.6% YoY and lifted its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% after modest 1.5% growth. Most peers delivered double‑digit growth, driven by AI‑led deals, while profit margins varied. Headcount attrition remained high across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI revenue or AI‑led deals as a key profit driver.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance; operating margins ranged from 14.8% to 24%.

themes.title: Talent churn
themes.detail: Attrition stayed above 12% at HCLTech and Wipro, indicating talent challenges.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
17.4% revenue growth and strong AI‑led deal wins.

laggards.why: Only 1.5% revenue growth and FY27 guidance cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% and guidance is flat.
